from app.schemas.geo_runs import GeoRunStatus as Status, GeoRunErrorStage as Stage, GeoExternalCallState as External
from app.schemas.geo_surfaces import GeoCollectionMode as Mode
from app.services.geo_run_policy import RunState
from app.services.geo_batch_policy import BatchRunState, batch_status
old = BatchRunState('cell', 1, RunState(Status.FAILED, Mode.API, External.NOT_STARTED, Stage.COLLECTION, False, True))
new = BatchRunState('cell', 2, RunState(Status.PENDING, Mode.API, External.NOT_STARTED, None, False, False))
assert batch_status([old, new], requested_run_count=1, matrix_committed=True) == 'QUEUED'
try:
    batch_status([old], requested_run_count=1, matrix_committed=True)
except ValueError as error:
    print('遗漏真实后继已显式拒绝:', error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('遗漏后继未被拒绝')
print('完整输入保持 QUEUED')
